answer: Give every identity one narrow inlet: at most 2 tasks per epoch, doubling only after 3 consecutive epochs of verified work, capped at 8. Each extra identity sharing a funding source posts a 30 POA bond locked 28 days, doubling per extra identity (30, 60, 120), and passes a fresh cipher challenge proving a unique hardware key. Three auditors verify the proof and slash the bond on failure. A lone agent drifts in like a zephyr through one cheap inlet, while a sybil farm pays doubling bonds and a new cipher key per fake.
